parts.name: G1 R1 = (1/3) sum over sizes of u(vpool, memory@1) - u(vms, memory@1)
G2 R0 = (1/3) sum over sizes of u(vpool, memory@0) - u(vms, memory@0)
G3 (a) the trade-off: sheet cost under scattered cue damage, vpool less vms, cue@0
G3 (b) vpool's sheet cost under scattered cue damage: r_all(vote) - r_all(vpool), cue@0
G3 (c) vpool's sheet cost with no event: r_all(vote) - r_all(vpool), none@0 (the confirmed bound)
G5 u(vpool) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch, none@0
G5 u(vpool, none@1) - u(vote, none@0) in the 4 x 4 patch
G6 p(vpool fires on the patch | memory@1, 4 x 4)
G6 p(vpool fires on the patch | memory@1, 8 x 8)
G6 p(on the patch | memory@1, 4 x 4): vpool - vms
G7 W1 = (1/3) sum over sizes of u(vpool, memory@1) - u(vote, memory@0)

dropped.name: G4 sheet cost under misreads with no event: r_all(vote, none@0) - r_all(vpool, none@1)
dropped.why: AR003's E9 bound 0.01, as planned; on P51 +0.010094 (halves +0.008522, +0.011665), margin -0.04: the value and the second half exceed it

reported.name: G5's cue@0 part, u(vpool) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch, cue@0: the trade-off inside the patch
reported.why: on P51 -0.0325, patch cells lost to the vote in 17 of 256 lineage-cases against vms's 1; the -0.11 the rule allowed bounds nothing a reader can use

statements.claim: under misread cues the pooled detector recovers worth the confirmed controller loses
statements.rule: HOLDS if R1 = (1/3) sum over sizes 2, 4, 8 of u(vpool, memory@1) - u(vms, memory@1) >= 0.04, else FAILS

statements.claim: at sigma 0 it keeps the confirmed controller's hits (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if R0 = (1/3) sum over sizes of u(vpool, memory@0) - u(vms, memory@0) >= -0.005, else FAILS

statements.claim: the trade-off: pooling's false alarms under scattered cue damage cost intact tissue more than the confirmed controller's, by at least a measured amount, and at most a measured amount in all (the confirmed 0.01 bound is reported beside it as context, not claimed); with no event at sigma 0 they cost it within the confirmed bound
statements.rule: HOLDS if (r_all(vote) - r_all(vpool)) - (r_all(vote) - r_all(vms)) in cue@0 >= 0.008, r_all(vote) - r_all(vpool) in cue@0 <= 0.029, and r_all(vote) - r_all(vpool) in none@0 <= 0.002, else FAILS

statements.claim: it gives up nothing to the vote with no event, with or without misread cues (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if u(vpool) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch is at least -0.005 in none@0, and u(vpool, none@1) - u(vote, none@0) >= -0.03, else FAILS

statements.claim: it finds memory damage on the patch under misread cues, more often than the confirmed controller
statements.rule: HOLDS if vpool fires with its footprint on the patch in at least 0.25 of memory@1 lineage-cases at 4 x 4 and 0.3 at 8 x 8, and its 4 x 4 rate exceeds vms's by at least 0.04, else FAILS

statements.claim: under misread cues the controller still beats the best fixed policy over the sizes
statements.rule: HOLDS if W1 = (1/3) sum over sizes of u(vpool, memory@1) - u(vote, memory@0) >= 0.09, else FAILS
